page.layout: One page of text, one column, running head centred at the top, catchword at the right below the last line. No page number, no margin notes.

main_text.p: ita fouetis, ut uix ullo ampliùs as-gantur relictæ patriæ desiderio. Ego quoque quamuis in illum e-ruditorum numerum referri nec uelim, nec possim: uestram atta-men in me humanitatem eximiam ac beneficetiam plane singularem facere non possum, quin prædicē, quoties uenit in mentem uestrorum in me, meosq; beneficiorum iucunda recordatio. Innumeri e-tiamnum alij, qui hodie quoq; munificentiam uestram experiuntur, quàm diu multumq;, ultro citroq; quæsiuerant certa sedē, hanc apud uos unicos tandem aliquando in-uenisse se, lubenter agnoscunt, & quasi naufragio erepti forent tu-tissimum tandem portum attigis-

page.notes: Printed hyphens at line ends are kept after "as-", "atta-", "e-", "uestro-", "in-", "tu-" and "attigis-". The last word is broken at the foot and completed by the catchword "fe fe". The word "munificentiam" is broken across lines 12 and 13 with no printed hyphen, so it is written whole. The mark after "e" in "illum e-" and "Innumeri e-" is a printed sign that I read as a hyphen, and it is doubtful. The "e" in "Innumeri e" may also be read differently. No page number is printed.
